messages:
anna: Morning — quick async standup for Slice-9 rollout.
What I did: ran the warmup script across the pool, applied the kernel tweak to kube-proxy on slice nodes, and executed smoke generation (10 hosts).
Blockers: seeing intermittent 500s at p95 from the model gateway under small bursts. My hypothesis is KV-cache eviction thrash on a subset of nodes; need SRE to confirm.
Today: plan to flip feature flag for slice-9 to 2% at 14:00 UTC, watch 30m, then decide ramp to 10% after +2h. Preparing rollback PR.

sasha: thanks anna. can you post the exact FF key and slice id so I can bind the rollout policy? also want to verify slowstart config.

anna: FF key: feature.slice9_rollout (env: prod). Slice id: slice-9-prod.
Curl toggle (will run at 14:00 UTC):
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/featureflags/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"key":"feature.slice9_rollout","enabled":true,"percentage":2}'
```

jamal: looking into the 500s now. pulled nvidia and gateway logs — not seeing OOMs or node reboots. There are frequent kv_eviction WARNs around the same windows.
I will add a short-lived KV cache metric to the dashboard and enable debug dumps on the suspect nodes.

mika: oncall — I'll be watching the alert channels during the first 30m. please ensure pages for 5xx > 0.5% and latency p95 > 1.2s are enabled.

sasha: can we enable slowstart and keep prefix caching off for this slice for the first hour? that should reduce cold-kv churn.

anna: yes — updating rollout config to slowstart: true and prefix_cache: false. snippet:
```
rollout_config:
  slowstart: true
  slowstart_minutes: 30
  prefix_cache: false
```
I'll push config to canary store and link in the console before toggle.

deploy-bot: Snapshot created: build-2026.03.17-slice9 (sha: a1b2c3d). Canary gate scheduled at 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z. Notify: @jamal @mika @sasha @anna

jamal: added temporary tracing filter to ignore noisy model-v2 healthcheck calls so we don't skew error rates. also left a small watch query for kv_eviction_count.

sasha: PR #4961 (rollback patch) is up, requesting reviews from @jamal and @mika. It contains the quick revert script + infra toggle.

jamal: reviewed #4961, left two tiny nits but safe to merge if needed. :thumbsup:

mika: no pages yet. I'll post a short update at +15m and +30m. If anything happens I'll page the SRE rotation.

anna: great — will flip at 14:00 UTC and post results here. tagging this thread for the post-30m status check. :white_check_mark:
